summary.title: Explicit citation of an original source
summary.description: This example represents a case where a later work explicitly cites or acknowledges an earlier source as an influence or reference.

trace_claim.claim_statement: The later work explicitly cites the earlier source as a reference or influence.

evidence_items.description: The later work includes a direct citation or reference to the original source.

location.excerpt: This work refers to Original Source Work as a conceptual reference.

evidence_items.description: The later creator acknowledges the source as an influence.

location.excerpt: The author acknowledges the influence of Original Source Work.

evidence.evidence_summary: The trace relationship is supported by direct citation and acknowledgement within the later work.

audit_assessment.assessment_summary: The explicit citation provides strong evidence of a trace relationship between the original source and the later work.
uncertainty_notes: This audit confirms the presence of citation, not the full extent of influence.
Citation does not automatically determine ownership, authorship, legality, or allocation.

review_notes: The citation is explicit and verifiable.
Further review may be required if this claim is used for dispute handling or allocation readiness.

allocation_readiness.reason: Explicit citation alone is not sufficient for allocation. Allocation requires a separate readiness review and downstream governance process.
allocation_readiness.recommended_next_step: If allocation is being considered, prepare a separate allocation-readiness review.
